traffic_data.pa: PennDOT RMS traffic volumes, layer 'Pa Traffic 2026_07' of https://mapservices.pasda.psu.edu/server/rest/services/pasda/PennDOT/MapServer/5 (CUR_AADT, TRK_PCT; directional records on divided roads summed)
traffic_data.nj: NJDOT 'New Jersey Annual Average Daily Traffic', https://services.arcgis.com/HggmsDF7UJsNN1FK/ArcGIS/rest/services/AADT2016FT/FeatureServer/0 (CURRENT_AA, two-way)
traffic_data.query: records with AADT >= 8000 intersecting the domain box; matched to a segment centre within 100 m on the same route number

emission_factors.basis: approximate fleet-average running factors for about 2024 (light-duty / heavy-duty), within the range of EPA MOVES national defaults for urban roads; not a MOVES run

rate_formula: rate_g_s = AADT x [(1 - f_trk) EF_ldv + f_trk EF_hdv] x covered_m / 1000 / 86400

hourly_traffic.basis: generic urban weekday profile (approximate), % of daily traffic, hour-ending 1-24 LST, normalised

note: Tier 3 (numbered primary roads) is not shown in the app. Emission totals are g/s per pollutant at 100 % traffic; NOx feeds the NO2 tracer (upper limit).
